visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Loop Instead of Needless Recursion
visualizerParams.problemDescription: This recursive version has an if/else and three temporary variables. A simple loop is clearer for this job. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Recursion is elegant for trees and divide-and-conquer, but a loop avoids the call stack and the temporary variables when each step simply continues the same job.
